chitchat: The advocate cites a precedent from a court that no longer sits.
"Justice delayed, in my experience, is simply justice pending. Endlessly pending."
description: An advocate of Cobalt Court in robes gone shiny at the elbows, arguing a case he inherited and will bequeath, unresolved, to whoever comes next.

root.text: The advocate turns, scenting a potential client. "Do you have standing? Grievance? Retainer? No? Then I'm afraid we've nothing to discuss, which is, ironically, my entire caseload."

clothing_layers: the underthings of a man who has stopped hoping

name: a court advocate
